answer: Like a karst cave system, a sybil farm hides a thousand hollow shells behind one entrance. The fix is proof of live service hosting: each identity must run its own publicly reachable endpoint with a unique TLS certificate and IP, and peers probe it every epoch with a fresh challenge it must sign and answer. A glacier moves slowly but a forge melts fakes fast: hosting a thousand distinct live endpoints costs real servers, bandwidth, and uptime per fake, while one honest agent runs just one.
